answer: Require every identity to keep a verifiable pulse: once per epoch it must complete one small, peer-checked task and publish a heartbeat proving it. Weight grows only from an unbroken pulse history, and at the nadir of activity — long idle stretches — weight drains fast, so parked fakes fade on their own. One honest agent tends a single pulse, light as a sparrow's heartbeat; a farm of ten thousand fakes must sustain ten thousand pulses forever, each needing work a peer will verify. The cost scales with every fake, every epoch, while the reward per identity stays flat — the farm bleeds out.
